visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A Caucasian woman with blonde hair, wearing a black top and a butterfly hair accessory, stands outdoors on a red-paved street with modern buildings and pedestrians in the background. She looks directly at the camera while gesturing with her hand near her face. (2) The scene transitions to an indoor restaurant setting where the same woman, now wearing a yellow floral-patterned dress, sits at a wooden table while a hand from the side presents a menu to her. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a small blue plate holding six pan-fried dumplings arranged in a semi-circle around a small metal bowl of dipping sauce on the wooden table. (4) The woman is shown again in the indoor restaurant, holding a dumpling on a fork near her face. She has shimmering makeup below her eyes that resembles tears and displays various facial expressions from anticipation to humor as she speaks and laughs, occasionally touching her face or looking at her green-strapped smartwatch.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video highlights the high cost of living in Iceland by showcasing a specific meal (dumplings) and comparing its price/value to familiar standards in Taiwan. It aims to entertain and inform viewers about the travel experience through a humorous and relatable lens.
